meta.name: ancient-chinese-calendar-determination
meta.description: Use when establishing an agricultural calendar or determining equinoxes and solstices. Guides celestial observation at four cardinal stations to fix seasonal timing using star positions and daylight measurement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据星象和日影确定节气与农时
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用传统天文方法确定节气与农时。
copy.tagline_en: Determine seasonal timing using star positions and daylight measurement.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to determine agricultural seasons using traditional celestial observation.

howto.what: 指导你设立四位官员在东西南北定点观测太阳和星星，通过昼夜长度和中星确定春分、夏至、秋分、冬至，并用闰月调整，制定准确的农业历法。
howto.when: 当需要建立农业历法、确定节气或安排农事时触发。

say.text: 帮我用古代方法确定今年春分是哪一天。
say.note: 你会得到观测步骤和结果。

say.text: 怎么观测中星来确定夏至？
say.note: Claude会解释观测火星等步骤。

say.text: 我想制定一个农历，请用四仲中星法。
say.note: 你将领到四方官员的具体任务。

howto.what_en: Guides the user to appoint four officials at cardinal points to observe the sun and stars, determine equinoxes and solstices by day length and meridian stars, and adjust with leap months to produce an accurate agricultural calendar.
howto.when_en: Triggered when establishing an agricultural calendar, determining equinoxes/solstices, or arranging farming activities based on celestial observation.

say_en.text: Help me determine the spring equinox this year using ancient methods.
say_en.note: You'll get observation steps and result.

say_en.text: How do I observe the mid-heaven star to find summer solstice?
say_en.note: Claude explains the procedure with star Huo.

say_en.text: I want to create a lunar calendar using the Four-Mid-Heaven-Stars method.
say_en.note: You'll be assigned four officials with specific tasks.
